indicators.label: Population aged 15+
indicators.description: Published census religion-table population aged 15 and over.
indicators.method: Use the published total row for each county and wave without adjustment.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Fifteen counties on each census wave's official Maa-amet boundary vintage. The product does not treat repeated county names as unchanged polygons.
indicators.quality_notes: Population aged 15 and over in the selected Statistics Estonia census religion table. Every percentage divides by the published age-15-plus total for the same county and wave; total population is never the denominator.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation (count)
indicators.description: People who reported or were estimated to feel an affiliation to a religion.
indicators.method: Use each table's published affiliation parent category: Follower of a particular faith (2000) or Feels an affiliation to a religion (2011 and 2021).
indicators.spatial_coverage: Fifteen counties on each census wave's official Maa-amet boundary vintage. The product does not treat repeated county names as unchanged polygons.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation (%)

indicators.method: 100 times the published affiliation parent count divided by the published age-15-plus total.
